name: Lift.KummerChart.JumpLattice.coordRetract_mem_withExponents
summary: coordRetract lands in kisinLoc, commutes with ζ (so preserves the letter part), and preserves the filtration conditions (with v = 0).

steps.claim: coordRetract(L)(y) ∈ kisinLoc(L) ⊆ kisinLocAinf(L), and it lies in letterPart(L, i): multiplication by ζ (mulZeta, an equivariant map) commutes with coordRetract (Hom.map_coordRetract), and ζy = ω(i)y.
steps.lean:
⟨⟨(coordRetract y).2.1, by simpa [mem_letterPart_iff_mulZeta]
  using mulZeta.map_coordRetract y (k.letterTeich i • y) (mem_letterPart_iff_mulZeta.1 e.1.2)⟩,

steps.claim: The filtration conditions: valueAt_coordRetract_sub_mem_hodgeFil with v = 0.
steps.lean:
fun a u v μ m ↦ by simpa using
  valueAt_coordRetract_sub_mem_hodgeFil m.1 y (zero_mem _) (by simp_all [withExponents])⟩
